hero.title: File:1961 Yuba City accident EOD stills.jpg
hero.credit: US National Archives via a FOIA request by the website Government Attic(Government Attic). Government Attic says the NARA film number is 342.USAF.27815. Direct link to video (76.3 MB).
hero.description:
Stills from a declassified video of 1961 Crash Scene of a B-52 Bomber near Yuba City, California, showing Emergency Ordnance Disposal Activities.
At top left: Part of one of the Mark 39 nuclear bombs thrown from the aircraft upon impact, possibly the forward ballistic case or the primary sphere of the weapon whose primary broke apart.
At top right: The afterbody and parachute of one of the bombs.
At bottom left: An EOD technician adjusts and uses a Geiger counter.
At bottom right: An EOD technician picking up what is likely a piece of scattered high-explosive from the bomb which broke apart during the crash.
categories: Accidents and incidents involving the Boeing B-52 Stratofortress

gallery.title: File:Mark 39 nuclear weapon casing diagram.jpg
gallery.credit: Hansen, Chuck (2007). Swords of Armageddon, version 2. Vol. V. Chukela Publications. p. 360.
gallery.description: Diagram of the external features of a Mark 39 nuclear bomb. The Access Panel to the Armed/Safe Switch is indicated. Section A contains the warhead. Section B contains the parachute pack. The text on the front of the bomb, per museum casings, likely said: "REJECT IF DENTED OR DEFORMED."
